instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: HoldGlass Preservation Release overview: The project creates and administers legal preservation holds. Matter leads request holds and identify the matter, people, and records; legal counsel confirms scope, records preservation instructions, and records when matters end; records coordinators send notices and record acknowledgements; and data custodians confirm preservation commencement and report unavailable records. The retention period and handler for unavailable-record reports are unknown, and stakeholders disagree about whether legal counsel or the records coordinator may issue a release instruction.

output.summary: HoldGlass Preservation Release creates and administers legal preservation holds. Matter Leads identify the hold subject and preserved records, Legal Counsel manages scope, instructions, and matter closure, Records Coordinators send notices and record acknowledgements, and Data Custodians confirm preservation commencement and report unavailable records. The retention period, unavailable-record handler, and release authority remain unresolved.
output.primary_goal: Create and administer legal preservation holds.
key_capabilities: Request legal holds and identify affected matters, people, and records.
Confirm hold scope and record preservation instructions.
Send hold notices and record acknowledgements.
Confirm preservation commencement and report unavailable records.
Record when the related matter has ended.
unresolved_points: What retention period applies to records under the legal hold.
Which role handles reports of unavailable records.
